title: Privacy framework and data governance
purpose: Enforce Privacy by Design: local/ephemeral processing, no persistence of camera/audio, no facial recognition, no hidden telemetry.
architecturalScope: Cross-cutting Platform concern. Applies to all adapters and the optional backend. Defines data-flow rules and tests.
domainContext: No domain state; defines policies that constrain infrastructure adapters.

milestones.title: Privacy policy and data-flow map
milestones.description: Every data flow is documented with locality and retention.

milestones.title: Enforcement tests
milestones.description: Automated tests prove local adapters make no network calls and nothing is persisted.

tasks.title: Define and run DPIA groundwork
acceptanceCriteria: DPIA outline ready before any field use.

tasks.title: Add privacy enforcement tests to CI
acceptanceCriteria: Tests fail if a local adapter opens a network connection or writes media to disk.
No audio/camera data is persisted or uploaded by default.
No facial recognition capability exists anywhere in the system.
safetyImplications: Loss of user trust is a safety-adjacent risk for adoption.
accessibilityImplications: Privacy controls must themselves be operable without sight and in simple language.
privacyImplications: This track IS the privacy guarantee.
